title: KRX data entitlement metadata (redacted)
description: Redacted metadata for a KRX data-rights entitlement. Stores NO contract contents - only a document hash and a storage reference - plus the covered datasets/uses/users, the effective window, and the lifecycle. Rights are never inferred from an API key or credential.

contract_document.description: Reference to the signed contract document. The document itself is never stored here.

document_reference.description: Storage/vault key or URL of the signed contract document - never its contents.

covered_datasets.description: KR-derived datasets the entitlement covers (e.g. krx_eod_bars, krx_instruments, krx_calendar).

covered_uses.description: Member-visible KR-derived uses the entitlement covers.

covered_users.description: User ids covered by the contract (redacted placeholders in committed fixtures).

effective_from.description: Inclusive start of the entitlement window (YYYY-MM-DD).

effective_until.description: Inclusive end of the entitlement window (YYYY-MM-DD).
